distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) provides the first Taiwan record of Arixyleborus rugosipes, including examined localities from Nantou and Taichung.

host_note: The source describes the species as polyphagous, with a possible preference for Dipterocarpaceae. Because no identified host taxon is provided, no host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Arixyleborus rugosipes Hopkins, 1915.

taxonomic_history.name: Arixyleborus rugosipes
taxonomic_history.note: Original description, p. 59; retained as the current accepted name.

taxonomic_history.name: Webbia medius
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 104.

taxonomic_history.name: Webbia camphorae
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 634.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) confirms Webbia medius and Webbia camphorae as synonyms after type comparison.
